product_metadata.title: RUGPADUSA, Basics, 6'x9', 1/3" Thick, 100% Felt, Premium Comfort Rug Pad, Also Available with Non Slip Option, Safe for All Floors and Finishes, Made in The USA
features: Durable Cushion - dense 1/3-inch thick felt adds soundproofing and insulation; non-abrasive to protect rugs and floors from scratches; adds extra comfort underneath rugs without extra bulking.
Made in the USA - 100% recycled felt needle-punched to prevent moisture buildup; odorless, low VOC’s, and hypoallergenic.
Safe for floors - chemical and adhesive free, will not stain, strip, or damage hard surface flooring; safe to use with hardwood, laminate, stone, tile, radiant heat, concrete, bamboo, and more.
Note to customer - this is not a non-slip rug pad, will not prevent rugs from shifting; should only be used with large rugs that are anchored down by furniture.
Total SATISFACTION - If you are unsatisfied with your purchase, please contact US (via message) and we will be happy to assist you.
